readme.run: Fit the diffusion tensor and NODDI inside a MindGrab brain mask
notes: Runs the web app's fit (the same noddi.wasm WebAssembly module) and writes
FA, MD, AD, RD, S0 and the principal direction, and with two or more shells
NODDI's ICVF, ISOVF, ODI and mean fibre direction, plus the brain mask.
MindGrab runs on the CPU and needs about 2.6 GB of memory. Give --mask FILE
to use your own brain mask, or --no-mask to fit every voxel. --threads N
sets the worker threads for the fit (default: one per core).
No network connection is required. Input is NIfTI with FSL bval/bvec files.
Please cite: Zhang H, Schneider T, Wheeler-Kingshott CA, Alexander DC.
